_comment: P25 precommitted, deterministic, auditable ROI + face-value grammar. Coordinates are authored sprite PNG pixels (origin top-left), traced from tools/mapforge_p23_architecture.py geometry (house_mass / temple / gate), NOT screen-space magic boxes. One source of truth read by tools/p25_face_grammar.py, measure_rois.py and tools/p25_validate_faces.py.
_rules: faces are graded in priority order (first match wins). Pixels are graded once. protect rects are byte-identical before/after. is_emissive (warm window/lantern >= r130 & r>b+40, or cyan/teal >= b110 & b>r+30) is never graded. dark_floor skips existing deep shadow/outline/recess pixels unless face.allow_dark. bright_ceiling skips highlights. Grade is baked OFFLINE into the PNG at generation time: zero runtime draw calls, zero per-frame bitmap allocation, zero alpha/size/pivot change.
